'''Drexler Ambar''' was a famous outdoorsman, [[Fisher/Legends|fisher]]man, and [[Big game hunter/Legends|hunter]] living on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Neftali/Legends|Neftali]]. He married [[Keturah Ambar|Keturah]], and the pair raised seven sons and a daughter all while operating [[Ambar's Big Game, Tackle, and Gear Shop]]. On the evening of Ambar's sixtieth wedding anniversary, he went out to check the ice pools and traps and never returned. Searches for Ambar found nothing, but Keturah refused to give up on her husband. For nearly ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]], Keturah hiked to the top of the [[Orane Mountain]] daily to watch for signs of Ambar.<ref name="BSS" />
